subject: 登封会善寺 · 元代大殿正面
author: Halazhang
source_note: Halazhang于2014年拍摄大殿，保留五间、三门两窗与歇山屋面。1300仅排序，不当作确切营建年。
prompt: Create a single precise architectural line plate of the EXISTING Yuan main hall at Huishan Temple, Dengfeng, based on the second image photograph. First image Longmen Buddha is STYLE ONLY: use its quiet fine black contour, clean white paper, no fill or shading. Draw this hall in straight frontal elevation with mild natural depth under the eave. Exactly FIVE facade bays divided by SIX columns: central three bays are timber doors, outer two bays are lattice windows on masonry skirts. One SINGLE hip-and-gable roof with distinctive curled ridge end ornaments and a SMALL CENTRAL VASE/BEAD FINIAL, as seen. Broad roof, deep eave, sparse strong brackets. Preserve low plinth, door geometry and broad roof-to-wall ratio. Remove trees, incense vessel, signs, people, wires, setting; do not add stairs or balustrades not in the photo. Simplify lattice to a few deliberate lines, roof to sparse long tile-flow strokes and small edge scallops; never shade tile surfaces or darken doorways. Omit all text from plaques, keep only simple blank frame. Entire building including both corner eaves must be inside the canvas with 8% white margin on either side and 15% above. One landscape 1536x1024 fine black contour drawing, pure white background, no black or grey filled areas, no texture wash, no border or labels.

site_recommendation.name: 登封会善寺
site_recommendation.lede: 嵩山南麓的会善寺，留下了一座五间元代大殿。宽屋顶、外露铺作与三组中门，将寺院悠久沿革落实在一座可见的木构上。
facts: 寺院创建远早于现殿，所绘大殿按元代现存木构登记。
面阔五间，单檐歇山顶，中部三间设门，两侧设窗。
图版只画现存大殿正面；屋面与门窗细部含历次修缮痕迹。
